errors.what: Connecting rod tilts the wrong way (its inclination has the wrong sign): when the crank pin is above the axis the rod climbs away from it instead of descending toward the piston pin, and when the pin is below it descends away. The rod's far end therefore does not reach the piston pin on the x-axis, so the rod comes apart from the piston and the slider-crank loop is not closed. It only closes at the dead-centre frames t=0 and t=2.
